t: Mr. J. Pure Requesting The Issue Of Special Passes To Him And To Members Of His Family

pages.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
REPORT
427
3-2-44
Station Foreign Affairs, S.B. File No. Date January 25, 1944

SUBJECT: Communication dated 17-1-44 from Mr. J. Pure
requesting the issue of special passes to
him and to members of his family.

（印：FILE）
薛文報告
不入

In accordance with the endorsement of the
Officer i/c Foreign Affairs on the attached communica-
tion from Mr. J. Pure, an attempt was made on 24-1-44
to communicate with him by 'phone. Mr. Pure being unable
to answer the call on account of illness, his daughter,
Miss Margaret(?) Pure, was asked to inform him that his
claim for diplomatic status has not been recognized
by the authorities and therefore no special passes can
be issued to him and to members of his family.

...G. Prokofiev...
A/C. D. I.

Officer i/c Foreign Affairs,
Special Branch.
pages.zh:
上海公共租界工部局警务处
报告
427
3-2-44
站别：外事科，特别支部档案号 日期：1944年1月25日

事由：J. Pure 先生于 1944年1月17日来函，请求向其本人及其家属签发特别通行证。

（印：归档）
薛文报告
不入

根据附呈 J. Pure 先生来函上外事科主管警官的批注，曾于 1944年1月24日尝试通过电话与其联系。Pure 先生因病无法接听电话，故请其女儿 Margaret(?) Pure 小姐转告他，当局未承认其外交身份，因此不能向其本人及家属签发特别通行证。

...G. Prokofiev...
代理副督察长

特别支部
外事科主管警官

January 19th., 1944.

Finland is the partner of the Tripartite Powers Pact
and has entered war against Soviet Russia in June 1941
together with Germany.

Mr. H. Tanner is the Finnish Consul-General in Shanghai
and Consulate is located at 301 Route Cardinal Mercier.
However Finland has not yet recognized the National
Government of China and there are no diplomatic relations
between two countries, but the Finnish Consulate-General
continues to function as before. The present status of the
Finnish Consulate-General same as that of the Swedish
Consulate-General as Sweden also has not yet recognized
the National Government of China.

Prior to incorporation of Latvia in the U.S.S.R.
on August 5th., 1940, Latvian interests in Shanghai were
represented by the Finnish Consulate-General and for this
purpose Mr. J. PURE was employed by the Consulate in the
capacity of a Secretary to look after Latvian interests.
However the Finnish Consualte-General ceased to represent
Latvian interests on August 14th., 1940 and all documents
and files relating to Latvian interests were handed over
to the Norwegian Consulate-General which then represented
Soviet interests in Shanghai.

Now Latvia is under German occupation.

From the above it may be seen that Mr. J. Pure has never
held any diplomatic status and now he may be regarded as
stateless citizen of Latvian origin.

（批：We can't recognize the official as the diplomat.）
（印：19.1.20）

pages.zh:
1944年1月19日

芬兰是三国同盟条约的缔约国，并于 1941年6月与德国一同对苏俄宣战。

H. Tanner 先生是芬兰驻上海总领事，领事馆位于麦利尼路（Route Cardinal Mercier）301号。然而，芬兰尚未承认中国国民政府，两国之间没有外交关系，但芬兰总领事馆仍照常运作。目前芬兰总领事馆的地位与瑞典总领事馆相同，因为瑞典也尚未承认中国国民政府。

在 1940年8月5日拉脱维亚并入苏联之前，芬兰总领事馆在上海代表拉脱维亚的利益，为此目的，领事馆聘用 J. PURE 先生担任秘书，负责照管拉脱维亚的利益。然而，芬兰总领事馆于 1940年8月14日停止代表拉脱维亚利益，所有与拉脱维亚利益有关的文件和档案均移交给当时在上海代表苏联利益的挪威总领事馆。

现在拉脱维亚处于德国占领之下。

由上可见，J. Pure 先生从未拥有任何外交身份，现在可被视为具有拉脱维亚血统的无国籍公民。

（批：我们不能承认该官员为外交官。）
（印：19.1.20）
（印：□□□□）

LATVIAN CONSULAR SECRETARIATE
86 TIFENG ROAD
SHANGHAI

No.2                                          Shanghai, January 17th, 1944.

Sirs:

With reference to our verbal conversation of January 15th with one
of your representatives, I beg to inform you that since August 1942
I was authorized by my Government to proceed independently with my
work as Latvian Consular Secretary which work I started in 1933
under the leadership of the Consul General for Finland.

According to diplomatic standings I am exempt of registration and I
shall be much obliged if you will be kind enough to issue the follow-
ing special passes to members of my family:-

Name             Passport      Date of Issue       Date of Birth
Jacob Pure       3415.C        8/9/30              March 3rd/16 March, 1877
Amalia Pure      3414.C        8/9/30              April 25th/8 May, 1879
Margaret Pure    3416.C        8/9/30              June 23rd, 1910
Nora Pure        889.E         6/5/34              December 24th, 1916
Alfred Pure      3676.M        23/3/37             July 15th, 1919

                                    I have the honour to be, Sirs,

                                        Your obedient Servant,
                                        Jacob Pure
